text:
Maria Chen: Taking the 6pm->2am oncall tonight. Quick pre-checks — can folks confirm VPN, PD, and runbook access? Want to do a smoke test at 17:45 PT.
Alex Park: I updated the runbook with the failover region note: https://runbooks.redwood.com/oncall-v3 (please don't paste creds here). Confirmed I can see the escalation policy in PagerDuty. VPN ok via Okta.
Jordan Lee: Ok from me. Ran `pd whoami` and it returned my user id. MFA is set.
Sam Patel: Re-enrolled my device for YubiKey this morning — VPN + PD look good. Can someone trigger a test page?
OncallBot: Reminder: rotation for #eng-oncall tonight. Primary: Maria Chen, Secondary: Jordan Lee. Runbook v3.1: https://runbooks.redwood.com/oncall-v3
Alex Park: For the smoke page use the test route in devtools: `/devtools pager test --team eng-oncall --target primary`. I'll trigger at 17:45 PT in non-prod so it doesn't disturb infra.
InfraBot: test-page scheduled by Alex Park at 2026-03-16T17:45:00Z -> status: queued
Alex Park: Sent test page to primary (nonprod).
Maria Chen: Got it — audible page + mobile push at 17:45. :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: Seeing routing logs: `route=primary, policy=escalate-5m, attempt=1` — looks healthy.
Sam Patel: Received backup SMS within 20s. All delivery paths good.
Maria Chen: Quick tooling check: confirm you have `rictl` configured. `rictl status` should return `ok`. If not, run `rictl config --load ~/.ri/config`.
Alex Park: `rictl status` -> ok. If kubecontext wrong, `kubectl config use-context infra-np` fixes it.
Maria Chen: FYI I updated step 4 in the runbook — metrics-prod IP was stale. Don't hardcode IPs; use DNS.
Jordan Lee: I'll merge the doc change and @mention docs for a follow-up to sweep other hardcoded IPs.
Sam Patel: Anything else for preflight?
Maria Chen: That's all. I'll post a short handoff summary 30m before my shift starts. If you see any anomalies after the smoke run, drop them here.
OncallBot: Test page result: success -> ack:false, response_time:12s
Maria Chen: Acking the thread. Thanks team — see you on rotation.
